title: Consent
description: consents/{consent_id} (PRD 12, SDD 12): one guardian's consent for one child, recorded when the child is added and re-recorded when the consent text changes. Written by the Account service (W1) only; read by the Account service (the session gate) and the Session Agent (W2) and Reading Coach (W3) mic gate. Append-only: there is no withdrawal in v1, a guardian who withdraws is handled by ops/delete_child.py. sign_in_method email_code is the Entra External ID one-time code.
